cost_model: half of lagged historical quoted spread, plus current-book measured p95 walk beyond best for 200 USD, plus stated adverse-execution allowance; adverse tick rounding and taker fees separately
definitions: Confirmed breakout: previous closed bar closes beyond the high/low of the preceding 20 complete bars; the current closed bar remains beyond that fixed boundary and closes at least as far in the breakout direction.

Band reentry: mean and population standard deviation use 20 closes before the excursion bar; excursion closes outside 2 standard deviations, next closed bar reenters that fixed band and remains on its original side of the mean. Direction is toward the mean.
Stops are fixed from the signal close using the registered ATR multiple. Entry one full minute after signal availability; an entry already beyond the stop is rejected.
Reversion entries require estimated net profit at the fixed mean, after entry/exit costs and funding reserve, to cover the account target. No assumed fill or profit is credited for rejected entries.
A maximum of one position in the whole account, BTC priority. No daily trade quota. Risk sizing includes round-trip costs and a 10% reserve of risk for funding.

No tuning after PnL. Secondary cases cannot replace the primary using the chronological check. These months were already observed in coarse strategies; this is not a pristine study-wide holdout. August-September remains reserved.
Historical analytics buckets are spread proxies, not archived executable books. Only completed lagged buckets may influence decisions; no missing-spread zero fill.
Current public book measurements are a short sample, not historical fills or latency calibration. Their use in replay is a present-day feasibility assumption.
Funding accrues by minute from the reconciled hourly rate; unknown intraminute exit accrual uses full-minute debit or zero credit, with uncertainty logged. Double-touch minute uses stop first.
